verdict_reason: Dropping CONTACT_PARTY from the seeded roles is correct and the test pins the five remaining roles, but a now-dead .filter(Boolean) and a single-use module-scope literal remain.

todos.issue: SELECTABLE_ADDRESS_ROLES keeps .filter(Boolean) (lines 8-10) after CONTACT_PARTY was dropped from the source list, but every PARTIES entry in parties.js now sets addressBookRole, so the filter guards a case nothing reaches and tells the reader some parties have no role
todos.fix: Must: SELECTABLE_ADDRESS_ROLES is built only from what PARTIES holds, with no guard for a party that has no addressBookRole. One way: PARTIES.map(({ addressBookRole }) => addressBookRole)

todos.issue: HTTP_CREATED (line 5) sits at module scope but only createAddressHoldingRole (line 54) uses it; the house rule puts a literal used by one function inside that function
todos.fix: Must: HTTP_CREATED lives in createAddressHoldingRole, the one function that reads it. One way: move the constant into that function body (HTTP_OK, used by two functions, stays at module scope)
